skill.summary: MASA Blazor 是基于 Material Design 3 的 Blazor 组件库，支持丰富组件、样式、配置及最佳实践的开发参考指南。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with comprehensive MASA Blazor usage guide.

- Maps all official documentation sections and subcomponents for quick access.
